### Christ is the Only Way to Harmony
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-february-28-2024.html
Passage: Matthew 18:15
Points:
- Unresolved division among Christians dishonors God and discourages the faithful.
- Genuine unity within the church functions as an evangelistic testimony to the watching world.
- True, lasting harmony cannot be achieved merely on a surface level; it requires Christ.
- Satan actively seeks to hinder the gospel through interpersonal disputes and relational division.
- Believers must take intentional steps to pursue peace and reconcile with offended brothers and sisters.

### Redemptive Discipline
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/redemptive-discipline
Passage: Matthew 18:15-17
Points:
- Loving confrontation reflects God's heart to restore wandering sinners rather than see them ruined by sin.
- Christians carry a biblical duty to watch over one another's spiritual health and growth.
- Confrontation of private offenses must begin one-on-one to stop gossip and protect church unity.
- Bringing witnesses after unheeded private admonition protects both parties and upholds biblical justice.
- Even if excommunication becomes necessary, the goal remains redemptive, and believers should pray for the person's salvation.
